summary: Grupo Aval announced the filing of its Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025. This is a routine annual reporting obligation, not a special situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change is described.
